newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Power plans T$1.6 bln to build bulk ships.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Power plans T$1.6 bln to build bulk ships.

text.p: Taiwan's state utility Taiwan Power Company said on Friday it would invest T$1.6 billion to build two bulk ships for its coal imports.
"Taiwan Power will build two bulk ships to carry the comapny's coal imports," a company official said, adding that the ships are expected to join operations in 1999.
The bulk ships, designed as Panamax-sized with 50,000-70,000 weight tonnage, are likely to be built by the state-owned China Ship Building Corp, he said.
The ships will be used to transport coal for power generators at Taiwan Power, which imported about 13 million tonnes of coal in 1995.
The shipbuilding contract will be signed in January 1997 and construction is expected to be completed in 1999, he said.
"Having two ships will provide Taiwan Power flexibility in shipment arrangements and save costs," a freight dealer said.
